image_description: A night-time shot of a street sign pole with multiple illuminated signs. The most prominent sign is angled upwards, glowing with red neon-style lettering that appears to spell 'ONE WAY' or similar, though the text is distorted. Below it are two horizontal rectangular signs, also illuminated, with illegible white text on a dark background. The pole is dark and textured, set against a pitch-black background.

artifact_observations.location: All visible signs, particularly the top angled sign and the two lower horizontal signs.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely illegible and structurally nonsensical. Characters merge into each other, have inconsistent stroke widths, and do not form recognizable words. This is a classic AI generation failure in rendering text.

artifact_observations.location: Mounting points where signs attach to the pole.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The physical connection between the signs and the pole is undefined. The signs appear to float or melt into the pole without visible hardware or logical geometric intersection.

The sign appears to be made of glowing neon tubing embedded in a solid panel, which is physically inconsistent with standard street sign manufacturing. The glow bleeds unnaturally into the surrounding darkness.
The perspective of the lower-left sign seems slightly warped relative to the pole and the other signs, lacking rigid planar geometry.
